* '''PC-E1''' ([[Peli Motto (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf)<ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages; publisher edition line “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”).</ref>, page 2, December 2025 edition: “While at Starship Graveyard, a Tatooine site, or a docking bay, power +3 and may cancel I've Lost Artoo! or Lateral Damage (or Restraining Bolt here).
